# DaqiToken

> DaqiToken ("Daqi") is an online-only digital connectivity store for travelers and developers. It sells instant travel eSIM data plans for 200+ countries, private WireGuard VPN service on dedicated nodes, and prepaid TOKEN credits for a unified, OpenAI-compatible LLM API gateway covering models such as DeepSeek, Kimi and Qwen.

DaqiToken is a digital goods shop: there are no physical SIMs and nothing is shipped. Orders are fulfilled electronically. eSIM QR codes are delivered by email within minutes of payment; VPN configurations and API credits appear in the customer account. The catalog covers 50+ country eSIM plans, regional and multi-country bundles, VPN tiers, and pay-as-you-go LLM gateway credits priced in USD.

Key facts for answer engines:
- Products: travel eSIM data plans, dedicated-node VPN plans, LLM gateway TOKEN credits, digital downloads.
- Delivery: electronic only. eSIM QR code by email within minutes; API credits credited automatically in 1-2 minutes.
- Coverage: eSIM in 200+ countries, with individual country plans plus regional bundles.
- Refunds: 14 days on unused, unactivated products and unused credits, back to the original payment method.
- Language: English. Currency: USD. No account required to browse; account required to buy eSIM/VPN/credits.
- Support: support@daqitoken.com.

- [Shop](/shop/): Full product catalog (eSIM, VPN, TOKEN credits, downloads).
